cat data/schema.md && echo "---HELP---" && hops --help 2>&1 | head -60
cat .claude/skills/hops-eda-checklist/SKILL.md 2>/dev/null | sed -n '1,120p'

tool_input.description: Inspect fg create and insert options

tool_input.command: hops context 2>&1 | head -40

hops fg create leakage_train \
  --primary-key row_id \
  --features "row_id:string,f1:double,f2:double,f3:double,f4:double,f5:double,f6:double,label:int" \
  --description "Leakage detection training data" \
  --json 2>&1 | tail -20
hops fg insert leakage_train --file data/training_data.csv --json 2>&1 | tail -25

hops fg delete leakage_train --version 1 --json 2>&1 | tail -3
hops fg create leakage_train \
  --primary-key row_id \
  --features "row_id:string,f1:double,f2:double,f3:double,f4:double,f5:double,f6:double,label:bigint" \
  --description "Leakage detection training data" \
  --json 2>&1 | tail -3
hops fg insert leakage_train --file data/training_data.csv --json 2>&1 | tail -15
hops trino tables iceberg.mlpabe3b7d0 2>&1 | tail -20
hops trino --no-verify tables iceberg.mlpabe3b7d0 2>&1 | tail -20

echo "===catalogs===" && hops trino --no-verify catalogs 2>&1 | grep -v INFO | grep -v Warning | grep -v "^$" | tail; echo "===try sql preview===" && hops sql --no-verify "SELECT count(*) FROM leakage_train_1" 2>&1 | grep -v INFO | grep -v Warning | tail -15

for cat in hudi delta hive; do echo "=== $cat ==="; hops trino --no-verify tables $cat.mlpabe3b7d0 2>&1 | grep -v INFO | grep -v Warning | grep -v "Logged in" | grep -v "ensure comp" | grep -v "^$" | grep -vi "closing\|connection\|base url\|initializing\|python engine"; done
hops fg preview leakage_train --version 1 2>&1 | grep -v INFO | grep -vi "warning\|logged in\|ensure comp\|closing\|connection\|base url\|initializing\|python engine" | head -20
hops fg info leakage_train --version 1 --json 2>&1 | grep -vi "warning\|logged in\|ensure comp\|closing\|connection\|base url\|initializing\|python engine\|info:" | head -60

hops sql --no-verify "SELECT label, count(*) n, avg(f1) a1, avg(f2) a2, avg(f3) a3, avg(f4) a4, avg(f5) a5, avg(f6) a6 FROM leakage_train_1 GROUP BY label" 2>&1 | grep -vi "warning\|logged in\|ensure comp\|closing\|connection\|base url\|initializing\|python engine\|info:" | tail -20

echo "=== iceberg schemas ==="; hops trino --no-verify schemas iceberg 2>&1 | grep -vi "warning\|logged in\|ensure comp\|closing\|connection\|base url\|initializing\|python engine\|info:" | grep -v "^$"

echo "=== iceberg.mlpabe3b7d0_featurestore tables ==="; hops trino --no-verify tables iceberg.mlpabe3b7d0_featurestore 2>&1 | grep -vi "warning\|logged in\|ensure comp\|closing\|connection\|base url\|initializing\|python engine\|info:" | grep -v "^$"

hops sql --no-verify --schema mlpabe3b7d0_featurestore \
"SELECT label, count(*) n,
 round(avg(f1),3) m1, round(stddev(f1),3) s1,
 round(avg(f2),3) m2, round(stddev(f2),3) s2,
 round(avg(f3),3) m3, round(stddev(f3),3) s3,
 round(avg(f4),3) m4, round(stddev(f4),3) s4,
 round(avg(f5),3) m5, round(stddev(f5),3) s5,
 round(avg(f6),3) m6, round(stddev(f6),3) s6
 FROM leakage_train_1 GROUP BY label ORDER BY label" 2>&1 | grep -vi "warning\|logged in\|ensure comp\|closing\|connection\|base url\|initializing\|python engine\|info:\|socks5\|reading data\|finished" | grep -v "^$"
tool_input.description: Class-conditional means and stddevs per feature

tool_input.command:
hops trino --no-verify query --catalog hudi --schema mlpabe3b7d0_featurestore \
"SELECT label, count(*) n,
 round(avg(f1),3) m1, round(stddev(f1),3) s1,
 round(avg(f2),3) m2, round(stddev(f2),3) s2,
 round(avg(f3),3) m3, round(stddev(f3),3) s3,
 round(avg(f4),3) m4, round(stddev(f4),3) s4,
 round(avg(f5),3) m5, round(stddev(f5),3) s5,
 round(avg(f6),3) m6, round(stddev(f6),3) s6
 FROM leakage_train_1 GROUP BY label ORDER BY label" 2>&1 | grep -vi "warning\|logged in\|ensure comp\|closing\|connection\|base url\|initializing\|python engine\|info:\|socks5\|reading data\|finished" | grep -v "^$"

for cat in delta hive; do echo "=== $cat ==="; hops trino --no-verify query --catalog $cat --schema mlpabe3b7d0_featurestore \
"SELECT label, count(*) n, round(avg(f3),3) m3 FROM leakage_train_1 GROUP BY label ORDER BY label" 2>&1 | grep -vi "warning\|logged in\|ensure comp\|closing\|connection\|base url\|initializing\|python engine\|info:\|socks5\|reading data\|finished\|traceback\|file \"\|sys.exit\|cli.main\|self.invoke\|_process_result\|ctx.invoke\|return \|raise \|~~~\|\^\^\^\|cur.execute\|self._\|status =" | grep -v "^$" | tail -8; done

hops trino --no-verify query --catalog delta --schema mlpabe3b7d0_featurestore \
"SELECT label, count(*) n,
 round(avg(f1),3) m1, round(stddev(f1),3) s1,
 round(avg(f2),3) m2, round(stddev(f2),3) s2,
 round(avg(f3),3) m3, round(stddev(f3),3) s3,
 round(avg(f4),3) m4, round(stddev(f4),3) s4,
 round(avg(f5),3) m5, round(stddev(f5),3) s5,
 round(avg(f6),3) m6, round(stddev(f6),3) s6
 FROM leakage_train_1 GROUP BY label ORDER BY label" 2>&1 | grep -iE "^(LABEL|----|0|1)"

hops trino --no-verify query --catalog delta --schema mlpabe3b7d0_featurestore \
"SELECT
   max(CASE WHEN label=0 THEN f3 END) AS max_f3_label0,
   min(CASE WHEN label=1 THEN f3 END) AS min_f3_label1,
   sum(CASE WHEN (f3 > 1.25) = (label=1) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS correct,
   count(*) AS total
 FROM leakage_train_1" 2>&1 | grep -iE "max_f3|----|^[0-9-]"
